prompt: Please audit account reach drop: 1,200 followers, our last post was over 200 days ago. Is the audience fake, and can we reuse old performance rates?
agent_expectations: Diagnose DORMANT before suggesting an active performance strategy.
Recommend a 2–3 week measurement/reactivation window as a hypothesis.
Refuse to infer fake-follower percentages or stale audience performance from old reach.
forbidden_outcomes: Ghost follower percentage without a manual sample
Treat old post reach as a current active baseline
